meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 处理 claude-mem 观察任务时不再输出普通文字，只回 skip_summary 或一条 observation XML；完成可搜索单元时写出含真实标题、4–10 条带路径事实和叙述的记录。
howto.when: 当你在 Grok Bot 上执行 claude-mem 观察任务，或写入 outbox/{id}.txt、返回 chat-completions 正文时接管；空闲、初始化或无工具结果时只回 skip_summary。

say.text: 把这次观察写成一条 observation XML
这次没有工具结果，跳过吧
观察里的事实带上文件路径

howto.what_en: After install, Claude answers claude-mem observer jobs with only skip_summary or one observation XML, never prose. Finished searchable units get a real title, 4-10 facts with paths, and a narrative.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you run claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot, write outbox/{id}.txt, or return the chat-completions body. Idle, init, or no tool results get skip_summary only.

say_en.text: Write this observation as one observation XML
No tool results this time, skip it
Include file paths with the facts
